name: Webform Payment Element
description: Webform elements for collecting multiple payment amounts with a payment provider.
project_description:
A webform form element that provides a simple payment element with machine (unique) name, label and dollar amount. Comes with a token to add up all dollar amounts in all items of a payment element or from multiple payment elements.
